title: Apply fraction addition to word problems

blocks.title: Recall equivalent fractions
blocks.instructions: Use an equal-whole model to connect 1/2 and 2/4, then explain why both have the same value.

blocks.title: Model a word problem
blocks.instructions: Teacher models a new fraction-addition context using common-sized parts, adds, and checks the total against one whole.

blocks.title: General paired practice
blocks.instructions: All students complete the same two unlike-denominator fraction word problems in pairs.

blocks.title: Apply to word problems
blocks.instructions: Students solve and explain fraction-addition contexts; the teacher circulates and records observations.

blocks.title: Explain an addition method
blocks.instructions: Students explain why equivalent fractions are needed and complete a short exit check.
